recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11231 unless a future work group decision changes QuestionnaireResponse.status or its status-reason guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11231 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for DSTU2 and asked whether QuestionnaireResponse.status needed an entered-in-error status code.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in git commit 679b3e63521fac0162890bb562da22a9463789e9, whose message says QuestionnaireResponse #11231 added entered-in-error to the status value set and whose patch updated the QuestionnaireResponse status code set and short display. Later source refactors preserved that application in the current XML StructureDefinition, CodeSystem, and ValueSet inputs.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has the entered-in-error-status build extension, includes entered-in-error in QuestionnaireResponse.status, marks the status element as a modifier because entered-in-error means the resource should not be treated as valid, and binds status required to the Questionnaire Response Status value set. FHIR-11489 provides broader workflow/event-pattern background cited from the seed comments but is too broad for this seed's per-issue reconciliation. Later community discussions and FHIR-41373 concern status reasons and Provenance/history, not removal of entered-in-error.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the authoritative current source already implements the requested status code and related conformance metadata.
